chunks: I did not call them to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor their own creation. I would not take as helpers those who lead (men) astray.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the creation of the heavens and earth and the role of jinn?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah in creation, specifically refuting the polytheistic notion that jinn or angels were co-creators or divine assistants. It highlights that while jinn are created beings, they are not taken as 'helpers' (awliyā') for guidance, emphasizing their distinct role as misleaders who require their own accountability.
